summary: First round of end-to-end testing for SENTIENT-AI (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 27 tests covering auth, catalog, filters, admin gating, category & product CRUD, leads/downloads/purchases, admin metrics/leads, AI recommend and AI chat streaming. Result: 27/27 passing. Frontend: Playwright end-to-end run against public preview URL exercised Home (grid, search), registration, /conta, product detail, AI chat widget (streaming reply received), Skills, FAQ (accordion), Community, logout, admin login redirect to /admin, admin dashboard (metrics visible), admin leads. All flows worked, no page errors, only expected 401s from /api/auth/me for anonymous visits.

minor.issue: Response returns the doc fetched BEFORE the $inc views update, so the client always sees a stale views count. DB is incremented correctly but the returned payload is off-by-one. Consider using find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER) so UI shows the real view count.

Uses raw request.json() with no Pydantic model; only 'status' is read and defaults to 'new' when missing (silently overwrites). Wrap in a StatusUpdate model with validation to prevent accidental resets.
Uses raw request.json() instead of Pydantic; no validation of product_id type.

issues: Language toggle button (data-testid=lang-toggle) has no visible aria-label; consider adding for a11y.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Return the post-increment product doc from GET /api/products/{id} using find_one_and_update(return_document=AFTER).
(Nice-to-have) Introduce Pydantic models for /admin/leads/{id} PUT and /purchases/track POST bodies.

(Security) CORS is currently CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True in server.py. Browsers ignore credentials with wildcard, but the config is inconsistent — set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend URL before production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes CORS wildcard with allow_credentials=True — should list explicit origins (FRONTEND_URL) for production.
GET /api/products/{id} returns stale views (doc fetched before $inc). Minor consistency bug.
Two endpoints (/admin/leads/{id} PUT, /purchases/track POST) parse raw JSON without Pydantic validation.
seed.py is executed on every startup with count check — fine, but no cleanup for stale legacy data if schema changes.
server.py is ~750 lines and could be split into routers (auth/catalog/leads/ai/admin) for maintainability.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@sentient-ai.com / Admin@123 (works). Test users created dynamically via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed already populated 12 products, categories, skills, community and FAQs on startup. Tests created ephemeral TEST_ prefixed products/categories/leads (cleaned up in same test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression baseline. Runs in ~12s with pytest-xdist (2 workers). AI recommend + AI chat streaming both validated live via Emergent LLM key. Frontend passed a full Playwright flow. Only remaining flag is the stale-views response in GET /api/products/{id}; DB persistence itself is correct.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues. See backend_issues.minor for the stale views details: `p = find_one(...); update_one($inc); return p` returns pre-increment snapshot.
